description:
Han Jitae, the beloved youngest son of Chairman Han of AK Group, has always been pampered.
Now a dominant alpha, Han Jitae has just turned twenty and begun dating Joo Kangwoo, an omega who is four years older than him.
This doesn’t sit well with Woo Hyunseung, a beta who has been Jitae’s bodyguard for the past eight years.
Not only has Hyunseung practically raised Jitae with his own hands, but after Jitae became an adult, those protective feelings gradually turned into romantic ones.
To make matters worse, the omega claiming to be Jitae’s boyfriend seems like nothing but bad news—someone who only drags Jitae down and treats him like a toy.
Meanwhile, Joo Kangwoo also can’t stand Hyunseung—the thug-like bastard Jitae trusts even more than his own older brother.
Jitae’s boyfriend, Kangwoo, quickly becomes his first lover, and Hyunseung, blinded by jealousy, ends up taking his virginity as well.
And standing before these two shameless men, Han Jitae—who seemed innocent and naïve—turns out to be even more outrageous.

“I like Hyunseung hyung just as much as I like Kangwoo.
So I want the two of you to get along.”

These three men recklessly throw themselves into a fiery relationship without realizing how dangerous it is—
Will they really be able to reach Jitae’s dream ending of happily living together in harmony?
